title: GWO-OP-SW: Order-Preserving Grey Wolf Optimizer for Selective Optimal Pulse-Width Modulation
description:
Code and results reproducing the tables and figures of the paper “Order-Preserving Grey Wolf Optimizer for Selective Optimal Pulse-Width Modulation in Multilevel Inverters”.

GWO-OP-SW searches a non-negative increment space and decodes it by a cumulative sum, so that the ordering constraints of the SOPWM problem hold by construction rather than being repaired or penalized. A square-wave convergence-factor schedule counters the premature convergence a monotonic schedule leaves unresolved. Evaluated on instances RC45-RC50 of the CEC2020 real-world constrained optimization suite.
